item.title: The Free Android Emulator for Mac M1, M2, M3 and M4
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gibo
item.description: Run Android games and apps natively on Apple Silicon. SiliconPlay is free, ARM64, with Metal graphics, keyboard and gamepad controls, and optional root for developers.

item.title: Looking for a BlueStacks Alternative on Mac? Try SiliconPlay
item.dc:creator: Ryan Gibo
item.description: Looking for a BlueStacks alternative on Mac? SiliconPlay is a free, native ARM64 Android emulator for M1–M4 with Metal graphics and optional root.
